post.caption: Elvis bought diamonds in a bathroom. On Christmas Eve in 1969, Elvis called his Memphis jeweler, Lowell Hays, to a movie theater. With no private room, he sat on a toilet seat in the men's room with the briefcase of jewelry on his lap. He bought three large diamond pieces as gifts that night. It was the first of about 200 purchases from that briefcase. Elvis took Hays and the case on tour, and handed jewelry to women in the front row. Hays made gold lightning bolt necklaces for TCB, Taking Care of Business, and Elvis later gave him one.
